subject: general
question: If △ABC ≅ △PQR, such that ∠ABC = 77°, ∠BCA = (x-y)°, AC = 48 cm, ∠PQR = (3x - 4)°, PR = x + 3y, then find the value of ∠QRP.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In congruent triangles **ΔABC ≅ ΔPQR**, corresponding parts are equal (**CPCT**).

∠ABC = ∠PQR ⇒ 77 = 3x − 4 ⇒ 3x = 81 ⇒ **x = 27**.

AC = PR ⇒ 48 = x + 3y ⇒ 48 = 27 + 3y ⇒ 3y = 21 ⇒ y = 7</stro
